title: eludite.agents.review input
description: Accept or reject agent edits held as pending changes, as the review view's Accept, Reject and Accept All buttons do. Accepted changes go through the workspace-edit applier (eludite.workspace.apply_edit's) as one undo step per open document; rejected ones are discarded. Either way the agent's tool call is answered with the outcome. Give exactly one of `change`, `path` and `all`.

change.description: The pending change's id as the window shows it.

path.description: Absolute path of a file with a pending change.

all.description: Every pending change (Accept All, Reject All).
